phone.title: Connect a phone
phone.description: Name the phone and choose who it belongs to. The next step shows a code to scan with WakeLink.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant and in the app, e.g. the owner's name.
data_description.person: Optional. The household only counts this phone while the person is at home.
data_description.url: The address the phone uses at home. It needs to be reachable from your Wi-Fi.

pair.title: Scan the code
pair.description:
In WakeLink open Settings → Home Assistant → Connect and scan this code. You can also open this link on the phone:

`{link}`

As soon as the app confirms the connection, select Submit.

error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
error.not_connected: The phone has not reported yet. Scan the code, check that the phone is on your home Wi-Fi, and try again.

data_description.person: The household only counts this phone while the person is at home.
